decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-199 MODIFY recording LED technology and selection of suitable LEDs compatible with the existing setup; no additional or edited Event is needed.
Selecting compatible LEDs for the BOM does not necessarily change the wiring-plan deliverable or its current documented attributes.
The LED component selection does not necessarily alter the completed system-layout or CAD-retention requirements.
The LED selection is unrelated to matcha mixing, frothing, whisk geometry, or whisk positioning.
The selected accent LEDs are not identified as food-contact components and do not change the food-safe contact-material standard.
The LED component decision does not change the dispensing configuration, spout material, mounting location, or pour direction.
The message confirms LED selection but expressly leaves the proposed button replacement unclear, so it does not establish a change to the decorative-control requirements.
Choosing compatible LEDs does not change the established beige and green color scheme.
LED selection does not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
The client cautions against constructing another base before creative alignment but does not modify the accepted enclosure form factor in this source decision.
The LED selection and general visual-appeal statement do not change placard text, placement, or viewing orientations.
Accent-light selection does not affect splash targets or mitigation requirements.
